Marie Foreman is a human and boxing champion of the UFS.

What, you wanna fight me? You're taking the world champion too lightly. Hmph, just know that I don't hesitate against anyone!
Marie Foreman

Personality
Marie is a competitive person unwilling to compromise, confident in her strength.

She has a bright and refreshing personality, and although she has many male fans, she has even more female fans. In the media, she is very cheerful and shows behavior that provokes her opponents, but this is just an attitude aimed at the media, and she is originally a very stoic type. She's a big eater, and she always complains that it's harder to hold back food in order to maintain her rank than her training. She especially loves sweets, and she has a habit of giving preferential treatment to sponsors from confectionery manufacturers.

Appearance
She has short red hair and yellow eyes.

History
Background
Marie is a Human. She is a female boxer who is currently said to be the most popular athlete in the American Federation.

Her base is bantamweight, but she is a champion in all weight classes, even heavyweight fighters are defeated by her flashy fighting style and tremendous sharpness. Her fight money is said to be in the hundreds of millions of dollars per fight, and she is known as the ``woman with the million dollar fist.''

However, her true identity is that she is an experimental subject for research on demons and Taimanin at a research institute in the UFS. Although she does not use her abilities during the match, she is aware that she has special abilities, so her policy is to take the match in as disadvantageous a situation as possible. Eventually, her goal is to fight against Taimanin and demons on an equal footing and prove her to be the strongest.

Timeline TABA
Only appears in a "what if" event, in which she interacts with Fuuma Kotaro (TABA).

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Fists

Boxing skills: Specially with a good ability to dodge.
Foresee Vision: Precognition, her ability to see into the future, allows her to see situations 3 seconds ahead. Because it is extremely nerve-wracking, it can only be used for a few seconds and cannot be used continuously. It is possible to change the future depending on her actions.
